claims: GO2-C1/C7: a candidate-validation refusal writes no preview; the outcome report names every operation, the refused one refused-by-validation and the others unassessed with the gates that did not run; the printed refusal and exit are byte-identical to the run without the option.

GO2-C2: every verdict word is reachable and correct; a refusal is tied only to the operation that adds or changes the element it names, and dropped-with names exactly the operations that need an element a refused operation adds.

The collecting D-12 walk (_d12_refusals) reports, as its first refusal, exactly the refusal _enforce_d12 raised before, for every constraint list, including IK2's induced confirmation claims and VG2's sample and common-sense branch.

GO2-C3/C5/C6: a preview made without the option keeps every byte and preview_sha256; apply refuses an outcome report; apply rebuilds outcomes exactly when the reviewed preview carries them, so an edited row is stale.
GO2-C4: no outcome row carries a constraint or sample value.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch this change adds handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.

question: Does every operation of a proposal get a correct outcome from gnd evolve preview --operation-outcomes, with no change to any refusal, exit, preview byte or digest when the option is absent? Find the proposal, refusal or input where an outcome is wrong, a refusal moves, or a value leaks into an outcome.
